Case Study Effects Co. browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Case Study Lastlight Overdrive Published on August 4, 2025 Case Study Effects Co. overdrive pedal Midnight Black Midnight Black Twilight Blue Twilight Blue Information The Lastlight is a transistor-based boost and overdrive pedal rooted in a classic overdriver circuit. While capable of delivering higher gain, fuzz-like tones, it is designed to excel in the low to medium gain range. The circuit has been reworked to provide a smoother and more gradual sweep on the gain knob, enhancing usability across its full range. The pedal also features a compact 125B enclosure with top-mounted jacks, optimizing it for modern pedalboard setups.
